description: Add Privacy page route to application

userStories.title: Add Privacy page route
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to import the Privacy component and register its route so users can access the privacy page.
acceptanceCriteria: Import Privacy from './pages/Privacy' at the top of src/App.jsx
Ensure <Routes> is imported from 'react-router-dom' in src/App.jsx
Add <Route path="/privacy" element={<Privacy />} /> inside the <Routes> block
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill that navigating to /privacy renders the Privacy page
